evidence_rule: DEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE when upper permutation p <= 0.01, otherwise IID_COMPATIBLE.

strategies.STATIC_INITIAL: Stay cooperative for the entire run.
strategies.RAW_SLIDING: Use the immediately previous window classification for the next window.
strategies.HYSTERESIS_2_ENTER_1_EXIT: Require two consecutive dependence-evidence windows before entering background sacrifice; leave background sacrifice after one IID-compatible window.

nonclaims: The regime labels are available only to the harness, not the controller
The 2048-episode window is not a recommended real-host observation interval
The hysteresis counts are synthetic controls, not production tuning
